The /data directory needs to be backed by a Volume, not the container's ephemeral writable layer — which resets on every restart
Add an emptyDir volume to the pod spec and mount it at /data — it survives container restarts within the same pod lifecycle
kubectl edit deployment counter -n dojo-docker-volume — add volumes: [{name: data-vol, emptyDir: {}}] and volumeMounts: [{name: data-vol, mountPath: /data}]
